Undelucram.ro on behalf of:
 EPAM Romania
 EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.
We are expanding the Azure Data Platform (ADP) platform team and are looking for a skilled Senior Azure Platform Engineer to help us build the infrastructure and platform enablers required to support our organizational data initiatives. This is an opportunity to drive transformation, enabling our engineering teams to accelerate the delivery of data solutions through platform automation, infrastructure, security, and self-service capabilities.
 We’re launching a Double Referral Bonus Campaign for this role in EPAM Romania open positions, covering candidates referred and hired between September 7th, 2026 and December 31st, 2026. The campaign applies to A3+ roles, for both B2B and permanent positions, across all skills and technologies.
 Responsibilities
Design, implement, and maintain platform features on ADP, ensuring scalability, security, and ease of use for development teams
Set expectations in terms of best practices and engineering quality for platform users
Contribute to DevOps practices across ADP, including automation, continuous delivery, and infrastructure as code
Partner with data engineers, developers, and product managers to ensure the platform delivers optimal performance and a smooth developer experience
Leverage Azure services to build robust, cloud-native infrastructure, while also ensuring integration with existing systems
Manage and evolve infrastructure using Terraform, applying best practices for cloud architecture and deployment
Drive Agile practices within the team to ensure continuous improvement and iterative delivery of platform solutions
Work closely with data engineers to create seamless data workflows and processes, particularly using tools such as Databricks
Help data engineers reach expectations on best practices set by the platform
Automate key processes across CI/CD pipelines and cloud infrastructure, enhancing platform resilience and reducing operational overhead
 Requirements
Minimum 5-7 years of relevant technical experience at mid/senior level
Experience working with Azure cloud infrastructure, with an emphasis on data processing, analytics, and networking in a cloud environment
Proficiency in Terraform, Databricks, and Python
Familiarity with Git, including GitHub and GitHub Actions
Proven ability to design and implement cloud platform features that improve developer productivity and facilitate self-service
Understanding of DevOps practices, continuous delivery pipelines, and Agile methodologies
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, capable of working across multifunctional teams to align platform objectives with business goals
Proactive approach to resolving or proposing solutions for complex technical challenges related to cloud infrastructure, scalability, and automation
Professional-level or fluent English
 Nice to have
Experience with Unity Catalog
Familiarity with containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes
Familiarity with building or maintaining internal developer portals, including Web Frameworks and Python API Frameworks
Experience in retail or e-commerce environments
Knowledge of Dutch or French
